items.title: ISRO and CNES to Launch Joint Indo-French TRISHNA Mission via PSLV
items.summary: ISRO and the French National Space Agency (CNES) are collaborating on the TRISHNA mission. The joint space mission is scheduled for launch next year onboard ISRO's Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV).

items.title: 5th Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan Awards Conferred
items.summary: The 5th Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan Awards have been officially conferred.

items.title: New UN Map Shows Aksai Chin and Arunachal Pradesh with Unspecified Claim Lines
items.summary: A new map released by the United Nations depicts Arunachal Pradesh and Aksai Chin between Indian and Chinese claim lines. It depicts the eastern border of Aksai Chin as the 'Indian Line' and includes a 'Chinese line' between Ladakh and Aksai Chin.

items.title: 2,000-Year-Old Megalithic Burial Chamber Discovered in Kasaragod, Kerala
items.summary: A 2,000-year-old Megalithic burial chamber indicating ancient human settlement was discovered at Nittadukkam in Kasaragod district, Kerala. Historians noted that local beliefs surrounding the site helped preserve one of the region's oldest surviving historical monuments.

items.title: India-Iran Bilateral Talks Focus on Chabahar Port Ahead of BRICS Summit
items.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry reaffirmed its civilisational ties with India, highlighting Chabahar Port as a major topic of bilateral consultations between the two countries ahead of the BRICS summit.

items.title: U.K. Recognises India's Carbon Credit Scheme Under Carbon Tax Mechanism
items.summary: The United Kingdom has recognised India's carbon credit scheme under its carbon tax mechanism. This recognition enables U.K. importers of eligible Indian goods covered under CBAM to seek carbon price relief.

items.title: Justice Sanjay Kumar Agrawal Sworn In as Chief Justice of Rajasthan High Court
items.summary: Justice Sanjay Kumar Agrawal has taken oath as the Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court. He assumes office following the tenure of Justice Sanjeev Prakash Sharma, who served as Acting Chief Justice.

items.title: FATF Warns of 'Digital Hawala' Aiding Money Laundering and Terror Financing
items.summary: A report by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) highlights that the fusion of virtual assets with traditional hawala systems is driving money laundering and terror financing. The global watchdog stated that nearly 70% of surveyed jurisdictions reported the integration of new technologies into these networks.

items.title: Government Reduces Rural LPG Cylinder Booking Interval to 25 Days
items.summary: The government has reduced the minimum booking interval for LPG cylinders for rural consumers from 45 days to 25 days. This decision brings the booking timeline for rural consumers on par with urban consumers.

items.title: Supreme Court Sets November 30 Deadline for Aravalli Committee Report
items.summary: The Supreme Court refused to grant an extension to the high-powered committee on the Aravalli hills, fixing November 30 as the final deadline for its report. The panel is tasked with creating a uniform definition for the Aravalli range and recommending mining regulations.

items.title: Satwik-Chirag Secure 10th BWF World Tour Crown Ahead of Asian Games
items.summary: Satwik-Chirag won their 10th BWF World Tour crown, providing a boost ahead of their Asian Games title defence.

items.title: NITI Aayog Launches PACT for Zero-Emission Freight
items.summary: NITI Aayog has officially launched the PACT initiative aimed at promoting zero-emission freight.

items.title: President’s Colour Presented to Goa Police
items.summary: The President's Colour honour has been presented to the Goa Police force.

items.title: Piyush Goyal Sets 10-Million Medical Tourism Target
items.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal has set a national target of 10 million for medical tourism.

items.title: UK Recognises India’s Carbon Credit Scheme
items.summary: The United Kingdom has officially recognised India's Carbon Credit Scheme.

items.title: Coastal Local Area Bank Gets Scheduled Bank Status
items.summary: Coastal Local Area Bank has been granted official Scheduled Bank status.
